items.title: Charlotte de Witte collaborates with AI vocalist NAVA
items.excerpt: The Belgian techno artist's three-track Azadi EP features vocals from NAVA, an AI-generated Persian singer created by British-Iranian artist Farbod Mehr.

items.title: SSL 4K sonible Assistance Add-on (review)
items.excerpt: SSL and sonible bring an optional AI 'mix engineer assistant' add-on to all three SSL 4000-series channel-strip plug-ins: hit Learn, pick one of 15 instrument profiles and an EQ/compression style, and it proposes settings.

items.title: At ADE 2026, a Top Music Lawyer Talks AI, Independence & What the Biz Can Learn From Radiohead
items.excerpt: At ADE 2026 lawyer Cliff Fluet argued that in a consent-based AI market the manager controls voice-and-likeness licensing, and that the club/DJ/live scene insulates electronic music from AI disruption.

items.title: AI-Generated Music and the Future of Creativity Discussed at Billboard Latin Music Week
items.excerpt: A Billboard Latin Music Week panel debated AI-generated music and how to protect human creators, with industry executives weighing consent, compensation and creative use.

items.title: Spotify Co-CEOs Talk AI Remixing Tool: 'We're the Right Company to Do This'
items.excerpt: On Spotify's Q3 call the co-CEOs discussed the coming AI remixing/cover tool for subscribers, framing it as a new revenue stream for licensed rightsholders.

history_match.title: Believe, TuneCore Artists Can Opt Into Spotify's AI Remix Tool

items.title: 'Movin' to the Sun' shows grey areas between AI and human music
items.excerpt: Hugel's dancefloor hit started life as a Suno-generated song from a human-written lyric and melody before being rebuilt with Ultra Nate's vocals, blurring the line between AI and human-made music.

items.title: MLC, Apple Music, & Others Face Subpoenas Amid UMG v. Suno
items.excerpt: Non-parties including the MLC, Apple Music and DistroKid now face subpoenas in the UMG v. Suno case, which could force disclosure of how much AI-generated music reaches DSPs.

history_match.title: Suno v. MLC Subpoena Dispute Boils Over as AI Platform Demands Multiple Years of DSP-Specific Streaming Data

items.title: Major Labels to Depose Menlo Vet C.C. Gong Over Suno Tweet
items.excerpt: A judge cleared Universal and Sony to depose former Menlo Ventures principal C.C. Gong over a deleted post saying she had shifted most of her listening from Spotify to Suno, testing Suno's fair-use market-harm defense.

items.title: ICMP Says Australian Songs Used to Train AI Sans Compensation
items.excerpt: ICMP warns AI firms are pressuring Australia to water down copyright for training, citing Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave hits already used to train models without payment.

history_match.title: ARIA boss warns Australian politicians on AI lobbying demands

items.title: Stop sending me vibecoded plugins, I'm begging you
items.excerpt: MusicTech's inbox is drowning in AI vibe-coded plugins; the piece explains why that is a problem for producers and which indie developers are using AI coding tools properly.

history_match.title: Who's Buying All These Vibe-Coded Plugins?

items.title: Is The Humanity of Instruments Under Threat from AI?
items.excerpt: As vibe-coded instrument plugins surge, Gearnews asks whether AI-built tools risk losing the human design choices that make instruments inspiring.

history_match.title: Google Wants You To Vibe Code Audio Plugins

items.title: Fender Studio Pro 8.2 Update: New Mixing and Workflow Features
items.excerpt: Fender Studio Pro 8.2 adds mixing and workflow upgrades plus AI-assisted drum and note extraction that converts audio drum hits and melodies into MIDI.

history_match.title: Why did Apple buy AI music startup Samplab, and how might this impact Logic Pro?

items.title: The 7 Weirdest NAM Captures You Can Download for Free
items.excerpt: Neural Amp Modeler, the open-source format where a model 'learns' how gear shapes a signal, now hosts captures of answering machines and walkie-talkies alongside classic amps.

history_match.title: Zoom Neurig: a $300 touchscreen amp modeler with NAM capture support and AI stem separation

items.title: Music Tectonics Returns Next Week With AI, Artist Revenue, and Our Future on the Agenda
items.excerpt: The Music Tectonics conference returns with AI music tools, artist revenue and the future of music tech on the agenda.

items.title: DJustify: Reason-and-Verify DJ Planning for Pop Transitions and Story-Driven Sets
items.excerpt: DJustify is a pop AI-DJ that puts an LLM in a reason-propose-verify-repair loop to jointly choose the next track, cue points and mixing technique, with an acoustic checker scoring rendered transitions.

items.title: MusicTwins: Training Audio-Language Models to Listen like Their Persona
items.excerpt: MusicTwins combines persona summaries, personal memory and post-training so audio-language models reproduce a specific listener's responses to music.

items.title: MI-MIDI 2: From Observation to Control with Sparse Autoencoders in Text-to-MIDI Generation
items.excerpt: Researchers test whether sparse-autoencoder features discovered in text2midi and MIDI-LLM actually steer generation, building an end-to-end protocol for controllable text-to-MIDI.
